title: Queue runs continue on days without team call logs
meaning: A missing log is not proof of no work. Call KPIs cannot be used as a productivity verdict after the logging break.
action: Re-export follow-ups and reconcile logging coverage with source owners.

title: Quote total is NULL
meaning: Revenue and monetary product rankings are not supportable. Currency ID 1 has no exported currency-name mapping.
action: Obtain populated quote/invoice line totals, currency definitions and revenue recognition rules.

title: Trip date is missing or unparseable
meaning: These quotes disappear from trip-horizon and future-trip cohorts.
action: Confirm when a trip date is mandatory; backfill from authoritative itinerary data.

title: Dashboard proxy owner cannot be assigned
meaning: Owner comparisons are incomplete; all assigned owners are approximations rather than authoritative sales ownership.
action: Export vtiger_quotes_info with effective ownership history.

title: Country is blank or N/A
meaning: These records cannot be assigned to Australia or New Zealand and are grouped as Unknown by the dashboard. Country is destination, not customer origin.
action: Validate destination capture and obtain origin-region lookup tables.

title: Trip date precedes quote creation date
meaning: Historical imports or date errors could explain these records; not automatically invalid sales.
action: Verify examples against source itineraries and import history.

title: Unmatched quote references in vtiger_quote_stage_track
meaning: Inner joins silently drop these child records.
action: Reconcile export scope and parent IDs before combining tables.

title: Repeated identical stage-log payloads with different IDs
meaning: Candidate duplicate emissions; event counts can inflate. Separate IDs are not proof of distinct business transitions.
action: Review repeated payloads and define an event idempotency key. Preserve raw logs.

title: Repeated structured follow-up payloads
meaning: Candidate duplicates, not proven duplicate conversations: free-text description and contact fields are intentionally excluded.
action: Inspect candidate records in CRM before deduplication.

title: Two spellings of rejection after confirmation
meaning: Suyash normalizes both spellings for stage groups, but timeline reversal detection searches only Confrmation.
action: Use a canonical stage dictionary in all metrics and timeline flags.

title: Call entries have no outcome
meaning: Contact-rate denominator excludes these calls, while call volume includes them.
action: Measure outcome completeness by agent/time and define a separate unknown-outcome category.

title: Call timestamp precedes quote creation
meaning: This can distort first-response time; imports or backdated logs need checking.
action: Reconcile source timezone and imported quote/call timestamps.

title: Historical dashboard basket includes later-created quotes
meaning: Treat as today changes dates but does not reconstruct the historical snapshot; live_basket applies no creation-date cutoff.
action: Label panels as export snapshot or reconstruct as-of states before historical comparisons.

title: Latest queue owner differs from owner available on 18 August
meaning: Historical accepted/lifecycle credit uses latest queue owner, including assignments after the selected day.
action: Use time-valid ownership and separate activity actor from sales owner.

title: Open Created/Requote quotes have trips before last quote-record date
meaning: Stale pipeline candidates as of 10 September; not proof the travel did not occur.
action: Review disposition and trip rescheduling; do not automatically close records.

title: Passenger count exceeds empirical 99th percentile
meaning: Review candidates above 200 pax; large groups are not inherently errors.
action: Compare passenger manifest and FIT/Groups classification for the largest cases.

title: Call records are dated after the review date
meaning: These are future-dated call_info entries as of 21 September 2026, not completed historical calls.
action: Check whether scheduled contact was recorded as a completed call.

title: Payment processing date is missing or invalid
meaning: Payment-date trends are incomplete; added_on is a record timestamp, not necessarily cash receipt date.
action: Confirm the payment lifecycle and canonical receipt date before cash-flow reporting.

title: Populated no_pax differs from adults + children + infants
meaning: Two passenger measures disagree; no_pax may use a different definition. Dashboard uses adults + children + infants.
action: Confirm whether infants/free-of-charge passengers belong in each measure before standardizing.

title: Country uses inconsistent casing
meaning: Raw groupings split Australia into two labels; dashboard title-case normalization already combines them.
action: Standardize the country dictionary upstream.

title: Quote creation timestamps cluster in one second
meaning: 327 records share one second, have missing creation actors, and are exactly the only quotes with populated totals. This strongly suggests a batch/import boundary, not an organic demand spike; import provenance is unconfirmed.
action: Confirm migration history and preserve original creation timestamps before using October 2024 as a trend baseline.

title: Current accepted-family quotes lack an Accepted audit event
meaning: Current state and event history cannot be fully reconciled; the first-observed acceptance series is incomplete.
action: Obtain full audit history or an authoritative acceptance timestamp before measuring historical sales.
